error[L0335]: a function value cannot be made from a known zero address
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/c-function-from-address-refusals/program.ldn:11:22
   |
11 |     nothing: adder = adder(0)
   |                      ^^^^^^^^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/c-function-from-address-refusals/program.ldn:11:22
   |
11 |     nothing: adder = adder(0)
   |                      ^^^^^ the function type applied here
  = note: [1975]: no code is at address zero; a lookup that finds nothing is its failure, not a function
